content.query:
CarbonBlackEvents_CL
| mvexpand todynamic(threatIndicators_s)
| where threatIndicators_s in ({ThreatIndicator}) or '*' in ({ThreatIndicator})
| where deviceDetails_deviceLocation_countryName_s in ({Location}) or '*' in ({Location})
| where deviceDetails_targetPriorityType_s in ({PriorityType}) or '*' in ({PriorityType})
| where eventType_s in ({EventType}) or '*' in ({EventType})
| where deviceDetails_deviceVersion_s in ({SensorOS}) or '*' in ({SensorOS})
| extend eventTime = datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(eventTime_d/1000) * 1sec
| summarize count() by bin(eventTime,{TimeRange:grain}), tostring(threatIndicators_s)
content.title: Total Events by Threat Indicators
